methodology.title: Methodology & Attribution — How we verify data
methodology.text1: The Rail Map adheres to strict factual verification: every published indicator (length in kilometers, number of lines and stations, daily ridership, investment figures and dates) requires a primary official source (public/private operators, ANPTrilhos, CBTU, ANTT, Ministry of Transport and state secretariats) with URL and consultation date.
methodology.text2: Whenever an indicator lacks audited official confirmation in our database, the field remains explicitly marked as 'data being verified' (null) — we never guess or fabricate numbers. Operational line alignments and station points come from OpenStreetMap under the ODbL 1.0 license, statically simplified via scripts/mapa/extract_osm_brasil.mjs.
methodology.osmAttribution: Geographic data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0 license) · Rendered with MapLibre GL JS · Open tiles by OpenFreeMap / CARTO.
